description: Build an unsigned EVM contract creation from bytecode plus optional constructor ABI and args (blocktools buildEvmTransfer create). Returns the initcode (data, no 'to'), initcode_keccak256, an approval of the initcode against that hash or a createHash you pin (blocktools evmApproveCall), a verifyTx check, and with 'from' the predicted address (deployer's pending nonce, blocktools evmCreateAddress). Value only for a payable constructor. Initcode is capped at 49152 bytes (EIP-3860). Creation is irreversible and the bytecode is not verified by SwapChan; say so. The user's own wallet signs and sends; SwapChan never does. Powered by blocktools (ABI coding). How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

abi.description: Optional ABI JSON to use instead of the Sourcify / Etherscan lookup (labelled as pasted; not checked against source).

args.description: Arguments in order; arrays/tuples as JSON lists, big numbers as decimal strings.

bytecode.description: Creation bytecode (0x hex), without constructor args

chainId.description: EVM chain id or name (1 eth, 8453 base, 42161 arbitrum, 10 optimism, 137 polygon, 56 bnb, 43114 avalanche, 59144 linea, 534352 scroll).

createHash.description: Expected initcode keccak-256 to pin; a mismatch fails the verdict

from.description: Deployer address, for the predicted contract address

value.description: Wei to send to the new contract (payable constructor only)

name: contract_build_creation
title: Build an unsigned contract creation (nothing sent)
